_comment: Canonical Ed25519 trust list shared by scripts/gen-manifests.py and the WebFlash wizard. Mirror of scripts/utils/firmware-trusted-keys.js — keep them aligned (enforced by __tests__/firmware-trusted-keys.test.js). See firmware-signing/README.md for rotation procedure and the meaning of each status value.

status_values.active: Currently signs production firmware. Acceptable in any mode.
status_values.superseded: Was active; legacy artifacts still verify in diagnostics. NOT acceptable for new installs without explicit opt-in.
status_values.test_only: Fixture/CI key whose private half is intentionally exposed (e.g. committed to a public repo). The wizard refuses signatures from these keys in production mode — anyone with read access could forge them. Acceptable only in development/test mode.
status_values.revoked: Must NOT verify any new install.
status_values.placeholder: Slot reserved for a not-yet-issued key. Never accepted as a verifier.

keys.comment: Development/CI fixture key. Private half is committed to the public repo under firmware-signing/keys/dev-2026-01-private.* so this key MUST NEVER be promoted to 'active' — anyone with read access could sign forged firmware. Production deployments MUST publish manifests signed by a separate 'active' key whose private half lives only in CI secrets. The placeholder fixtures shipped in this repo are signed by this key purely so end-to-end tests exercise the real verification path; they are NOT installable from the deployed wizard.
